edges.label: Air Force denials of Hangar 18 bodies
edges.note: Robert Spencer Carr's 1974 public claim that bodies recovered near Aztec were held at 'Hangar 18' at Wright-Patterson AFB drew official Air Force denials. The FBI separately disowned the Guy Hottel memo, the one federal document ever cited as corroboration, in a published 2013 statement.

edges.label: The Hottel memo predates and partly parallels the Aztec narrative
edges.note: Hottel's memo of 22 March 1950 describes three fifty-foot discs with three-foot occupants two months before Scully's book described one ninety-nine-foot disc with sixteen. The narratives are related but not identical, so the memo is better read as evidence that the recovery rumour was already in official circulation than as independent confirmation of Aztec.
